title: 第二十二章 鱼海第二十三章 第二次轮回任务
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
器殿从外观上来看，像是小号天帝殿，不过殿内的雕像并非是天帝雕像，而是一尊林阳不认识的神灵。
看守器殿的是一名穿着灰蒙蒙道袍的中年人。整个人透露出一股天地高远的奇异气质，林阳在入门仪式上见过他，是玄天宗的一位外景长老。
“虚灵长老，掌门真人让我来取走一件宝兵。”林阳边说边递出翠绿色泽的令牌。
灰蒙蒙道袍的中年虚灵接过令牌稍作验证后，微笑道：“是清阳师侄啊，既然掌门有令，那你便去吧。”
拜入玄天宗，林阳乃是‘清’字辈，取道号时用了他名‘阳’字，因此他的道号是‘清阳’。
“有劳长老。”
林阳迈步走进器殿之中的兵器阁。除此之外还有秘宝阁等等分类。
他离去后，虚灵微微感叹道：“果真如同传言一般天资无双，这才几日就转修完根本大法。”
守静能让林阳来器殿挑选宝兵，明显是林阳完成了根本大法的转修，看样子是要下山游历一段时间了。
林阳不知他走后的事情。此刻，他进入兵器阁后，略过了数以千百计的利器级数的刀枪剑戟。目光直勾勾的盯着阁内十数件装在洁白玉匣内，散发阵阵可怖气机的宝兵。
总计一十六件宝兵。七柄剑型，五柄刀型，三柄长枪型，一柄法珠型。
他直接忽略过长枪以及法珠类型的宝兵，细细打量着刀剑型的宝兵。
“我现在有外景级雷性的狻猊宝术，外景级火性的火皇焚乾坤，选择属性不符的宝兵，难以将招式威力以及宝兵之力催动到极致。”
林阳做出了选择，他取下了一盒玉匣，内里装着一柄通体赤红，宽厚的刀身有紫色雷纹的长刀，造型似是他记忆中的唐刀，不过要宽上许多。
玉匣刻着关于这件宝兵的介绍。
煌劫，中品宝兵，地陨真核铸身，玄雷之精化为纹理，凤鸟栖木为柄，雷火交织，锋利难挡，若全力而为，可带来方圆十里天象变化。
背负着玉匣回到器殿殿门口，待到虚灵做好登记之后，林阳便返回了宗门分配给自己的庭院。
不同于利器级武器，宝兵想要发挥完全威力，除了战时元气的供给外，还需要日日夜夜的进行共鸣。
林阳将煌劫从玉匣内取出，他盘坐床上，内天地开始勾连煌劫的气息。
中品宝兵对应外景中跨过了第一层天梯的绝顶高手，他境界虽然高深，但始终未进行内外交汇，想要掌握煌劫这件中品宝兵还不知要多少时日。

鱼海是戈壁之中难得的大湖，烟波浩渺，遍生绿草杂树，乃是瀚海一带最繁华之地，自古以来素有‘小江东’之称，
林阳自玄天宗所处中原，一路远行穿过茫茫沙漠戈壁，刚进入鱼海，就有水汽扑面而来，有一种皮肤被滋润的感觉。
虽然比起中原此地还是略显干燥，但也超过沙漠戈壁不知凡几。
此刻距离他最初祭练煌劫，已经过去了两个多月，一路上走走停停，终于抵达了此行的目的地。
湖泊旁边有座巨石搭建的城池，林阳定睛遥望，里面房舍鳞次栉比，人烟稠密，喧嚣动耳，有中原打扮者，有沙客模样者，有帽子和衣裙鲜艳漂亮的西域少女，也有穿着大胆火辣的胡娘，红尘气息浓郁，这能让每一位从荒凉，枯燥的戈壁而来的旅人不想离开。
如果说马匪横行的枯燥戈壁是地狱，那么此处就是传说中的天堂了。
在一路上他打听过关于鱼海的消息，知道这鱼海之主白霸征交游广阔，与几大马匪首领的关系不错。否则以他开了九窍的实力，怎么也占据不了鱼海这一处繁华之地。
走进城中，城内是白墙黑瓦，楼舍林立的建筑风格，让林阳有一种又回到江东茂陵的错觉，只可惜在城市规模上要小了太多。
有着白霸征这位鱼海之主，城内倒也说不上混乱，有初步的秩序，谁敢杀人犯事，必会面临白霸征的追杀令。
找到一家人气兴旺的酒楼，林阳点上酒菜，边吃边欣赏窗外的异域风情。
未来不知要在鱼海住多久，他准备先在本地购买一套房产，住在客栈始终不方便。
或许，不需要自己出面买。
林阳心中若有所思，刚刚进城时，有人应该认出了他，看当时那人的反应，十有八九是去跟自家的老大报信去了。
他一身玄衣道袍，背负一刀一剑，如此明显的装扮，只要是有心人都能认出来，要不是此地乃是西域，和中原隔了沙漠戈壁来往不变，此刻街上早就有人惊呼了。
“‘修罗刀’韩罗的马队前段时间和‘立地阎罗’尤还多发生了冲突。”
“尤还多乃是赫连山七十二匪的首领，韩罗他莫不是失了智？怎么敢和尤还多作对？”
“谁知道这‘修罗刀’是怎么想的，本来还算是一方小势力，这一下，被杀的七七八八。”
这时，一个身高挺拔，体型壮硕满脸凶悍之气的男人，在一群人的簇拥下，走进了客栈。他眼神扫视客栈，接着一亮，快步来到林阳身前，不卑不亢的问道：“这位道长，可是清阳道长？”
微微颔首，林阳问道：“你是何人？”

“白霸征，蒙江湖朋友抬举，暂为这鱼海之主。”白霸征接着开口了：“不知清阳道长是路过鱼海还是久居？好让我招待一番。”
本来他在城主府中过得潇洒，没想到有手下人汇报，有疑似‘归真返璞’林阳的道士入了城，这使得他没心思再玩乐，急匆匆的就赶了过来。
外景之下第一高手这种名头，可不是说笑的，在某些场合中，比寻常外景还要具有威慑。自己虽然和几位外景境的马匪头领交好，但是遇上林阳这种人物也要释放善意。免得造成误会，出现不必要的损失。
“近日闲极无聊外出游历天下，今日到了此地，发现城内种种符合我胃口，准备长住一段时间，白城主可有指教？”
“这城治理的应了道长的口味，是我的荣幸，稍后还请道长移步，让我一尽地主之谊。”白霸征话语之中把自身放在很低的位置，难怪他交游广阔，花花轿子抬人谁都喜欢。
content_en:
From the appearance, the Qi Palace looks like a small Heavenly Emperor Palace, but the statue in the hall is not that of the Heavenly Emperor, but a god that Lin Yang does not recognize.
The person guarding the Palace of Instruments is a middle-aged man wearing a gray Taoist robe. The whole person revealed a strange aura of being far above the world. Lin Yang had seen him during the initiation ceremony. He was an on-location elder of the Xuantian Sect.
"Elder Xu Ling, the leader asked me to take away a treasured weapon." Lin Yang said as he handed over the emerald green token.
The middle-aged Xu Ling in a gray Taoist robe took the token and verified it for a moment, then smiled and said: "It's the nephew of Qingyang. Since the master has the order, then you can go."
When he joined the Xuantian Sect, Lin Yang was from the generation with the character 'Qing'. When he took his Taoist name, he used the character 'Yang' in his name, so his Taoist name was 'Qingyang'.
"Elder You Lao."
Lin Yang stepped into the weapons pavilion in the weapon palace. In addition, there are also categories such as Secret Treasure Pavilion.
After he left, Xu Ling sighed slightly: "As expected, he is as talented as the rumors. He has completed practicing the fundamental method in just a few days."
Shoujing allowed Lin Yang to come to the Weapon Hall to select treasure weapons. It was obvious that Lin Yang had completed the transformation of the basic Dafa and it seemed that he was going to travel down the mountain for a while.
Lin Yang didn't know what happened after he left. At this moment, after he entered the weapons pavilion, he passed by thousands of swords, guns, swords and halberds of sharp weapon level. He stared straight at the dozens of treasured weapons in the pavilion that were contained in white jade boxes and emitted bursts of terrifying energy.
A total of sixteen treasures. Seven-handled sword type, five-handled knife type, three-handled spear type, and one handled magic bead type.
He directly ignored the spear and magic bead-type treasure weapons, and carefully looked at the sword-type treasure weapons.
"I currently have the location-level thunderous Suan Ni Treasure Technique, and the location-level fire-level Fire Emperor Burning the World. I have chosen treasure weapons with inconsistent attributes, and it is difficult to maximize the power of the moves and the power of the weapons."
Lin Yang made his choice. He took down a box of jade, which contained a long sword that was completely red and had purple thunder patterns on its broad blade. The shape was similar to the Tang sword in his memory, but it was much wider.
The jade box is engraved with an introduction to this treasure.
Huang Jie, a middle-grade treasure weapon, the body is made from the true core of earth meteorites, the essence of mysterious thunder is turned into texture, the phoenix bird perch is used as the handle, the thunder and fire are intertwined, and it is sharp and unstoppable. If it is used with all its strength, it can bring about changes in the celestial phenomena within a ten-mile radius.
Carrying the jade box on his back, he returned to the entrance of the Qi Palace. After Xu Ling completed the registration, Lin Yang returned to the courtyard assigned to him by the sect.
Different from sharp weapon level weapons, if Baobin wants to exert its full power, in addition to the supply of vitality during wartime, it also needs to resonate day and night.
Lin Yang took Huang Jie out of the jade box. He sat cross-legged on the bed, and the inner world began to connect with Huang Jie's aura.
The middle-grade treasure weapon corresponds to the top master who has crossed the first level of the ladder in the exterior scene. Although his realm is advanced, he has never communicated internally or externally. It is still unknown how long it will take to master the middle-grade treasure weapon of Huang Jie.
…
Yuhai is a rare large lake in the Gobi. It is vast and covered with green grass and trees. It is the most prosperous place in the Hanhai area. It has been known as "Little Jiangdong" since ancient times.
Lin Yang traveled all the way from the Central Plains where Xuantian Sect was located, through the vast desert Gobi. As soon as he entered the sea of ​​fish, water vapor hit his face, and he felt like his skin was being moisturized.
Although it is still slightly drier than the Central Plains, it is still much drier than the Gobi Desert.
At this moment, more than two months have passed since he first practiced Huangjie. He stopped and stopped along the way and finally arrived at the destination of his trip.
There was a city built of huge stones next to the lake. Lin Yang looked intently into the distance. There were rows of houses inside, densely populated, and noisy. There were people dressed in Central Plains clothes, some people who looked like Shake, some girls from the Western Regions with bright and beautiful hats and dresses, and some Hu Niang in bold and hot clothes. The smell of red dust was strong, which would make every traveler from the desolate and boring Gobi not want to leave.
If the boring Gobi desert where horse bandits are rampant is hell, then this place is the legendary heaven.Done.
Along the way, he inquired about the news about Yuhai and learned that Bai Bazheng, the lord of Yuhai, had many connections and had a good relationship with several major horse bandit leaders. Otherwise, with the strength of his nine orifices, he would never be able to occupy the prosperous place of Yuhai.
Walking into the city, the city has white walls and black tiles, and the architectural style of numerous buildings gives Lin Yang the illusion of returning to Maoling, Jiangdong, but it is a pity that the scale of the city is much smaller.
With Bai Ba Zheng, the Lord of the Fish and Sea, the city can't be said to be chaotic. There is preliminary order. Anyone who dares to commit murder and commit crimes will definitely face Bai Ba Zheng's pursuit order.
Finding a popular restaurant, Lin Yang ordered wine and food and enjoyed the exotic scenery outside the window while eating.
He doesn't know how long he will live in Yuhai in the future. He plans to buy a local property first. Living in an inn is always inconvenient.
Perhaps, you don’t need to come out and buy it yourself.
Lin Yang was thoughtful. When he first entered the city, someone should have recognized him. Judging from the reaction of that person at that time, he most likely went to report the news to his boss.
He was dressed in a mysterious Taoist robe and carried a sword on his back. Anyone with such an obvious attire could recognize him. If it weren't for the fact that this was the Western Region, and the Central Plains were separated by the Gobi Desert, there would have been people on the street exclaiming at this moment.
"'Shura Sword' Han Luo's cavalry had a conflict with 'Lidi Yama' You Huaduo some time ago."
"You Huanduo is the leader of the seventy-two bandits in Helian Mountain. Has Han Luo lost his mind? How dare he go against You Huanduo?"
"Who knows what this 'Shura Sword' is thinking? It was originally a small force, but now, hundreds of people were killed."
At this time, a tall, muscular man with a fierce face walked into the inn surrounded by a group of people. His eyes scanned the inn, then brightened, and he quickly came to Lin Yang and asked in a neither humble nor arrogant manner: "Is this Taoist Priest Qingyang?"
Nodding slightly, Lin Yang asked, "Who are you?"
"Bai Ba Zheng, promoted by friends in the Jianghu, is temporarily the Lord of this fish sea." Bai Ba Zheng then spoke: "I wonder if Taoist Qingyang has passed by the fish sea or has lived there for a long time? So that I can entertain you."
He was originally living a comfortable life in the city lord's mansion, but he didn't expect that one of his subordinates reported that a Taoist priest suspected of "returning to his true nature" Lin Yang had entered the city. This made him no longer in the mood to have fun, so he hurried over.
The title of being the number one master in outdoor scenes is no joke. In some situations, it is even more intimidating than ordinary outdoor scenes. Although I am on good terms with several horse bandit leaders in the exterior scenes, I still have to show my kindness when I meet someone like Lin Yang. To avoid misunderstandings and unnecessary losses.
"I've been traveling all over the world recently because I've been very bored. I arrived here today and found that everything in the city suits my taste. I'm planning to stay for a long time. Can Lord Bai give me some advice?"
"It is an honor for me that this city is managed according to the taste of the Taoist priest. Later, I will ask the Taoist priest to move over and let me fulfill my duties as a landlord." Bai Bazheng put himself in a very low position in his words. It is no wonder that he has a wide circle of friends and is loved by everyone who carries the sedan chair.
